CLOSED 00:20 CST Nov 15 on option c, the consultant's pick under your 20:18 words, not typed by you; your 00:09 save was "none of these ... whichever is easiest and then leave this as a note to come back to on q_max". TRADE for you (one line): option c drops your own 326 a, "hide only the provider's text", so the provider's raw text can reach the screen (usually a fault such as 'prompt is too long' or an overload, never the key); no code change.
Come back to this on q_max if you want 326 a kept; ruling own-328-c reopens if you say otherwise.
YOUR WORD (page save 00:09 CST Nov 15): "none of these", note: "whichever is easiest and then leave this as a note to come back to on q_max". Triage did not pick: the plainly easiest option is not clear from the item (b is a small screen change; c needs no code but drops your own 326 a). The item stays open as a note to come back to on q_max; nothing is built.
ANSWER to your question (20:30 CST Nov 14): yes, one rule of yours forces this choice: your 326 a, "hide only the provider's text". The server's reason column holds its own sentences and the provider's raw text, with nothing marking which is which. So "hide only the provider's text" needs a mark at the source (a) or a short allow-list on the screen (b). Drop 326 a (c) and neither is needed: the screen shows the reason as is, and the provider's raw text can reach it (the lane read says no key or header can). Only you can decide this; the code cannot. The q_max code is outside this repo, so triage read none of it, and whether this change is built is unknown.
Goal: a resumed failed run shows why it failed, and hides only the provider's raw text.
Problem (rule): the job row's error column holds both the server's own sentences and the provider's raw text, with nothing marking which is which (src/worker/reconcileWorker.ts writes error.message; claudeProvider.ts throws provider text unchanged).
Why yours: it is a product decision, what a failed run shows the user (D-369). The code cannot choose it. Your 326 a, 'hide only the provider's text', is what forces the choice. If you drop 326 a, the resumed view shows the row's reason as is, and neither a nor b is needed.
Based on (read): today recoverRun (src/components/Chat.tsx) sends every reason through answerFailure (src/utils/plainReason.ts), which drops all but the network and no-key reasons.
Based on (read): lane qmax-browser-main-red read claudeProvider.ts at 12:12 CST: no key and no header can reach the text. The provider's own words pass through as is; whether they can quote part of a request is unmeasured and likely small.
Departs from: main hides every resumed reason — the resumed view shows the row's reason.
